basic_info.description: Located on a charming tree-lined block in Parkside, this tunnel-entrance home is just a few blocks from Noriega Street's shops and restaurants, public transit along Sunset Boulevard, Quintara St, and Noriega St, as well as several schools - including two elementary schools, a middle school, and a private high school within several blocks away. West Sunset Playground and Ocean Beach are within sight. The home features a well-desired layout with 3 bedrooms & 2 bathrooms (including primary suite), a private deck, a spacious living room & a dining room with partial ocean views, and a kitchen with eat-in area all on the top floor. The ground level includes a legal room with a half bath, plus an additional unwarranted room and bath. A spacious two-car tandem garage provides ample storage space and potential for future expansion. The large backyard, surrounded by lush trees and greenery, offers a private retreat. Recent updates include fresh interior and exterior paint, newly refinished hardwood floors, and new flooring in the ground-level living spaces, making this home move-in ready!
